pass_rule: Both calls must succeed under current OAuth authorization and return parseable current account state; empty/zero positions are valid known exposure, but permission errors are never PASS.
repair: Reconnect/re-authorize Longbridge OAuth with the full permissions required by the connector. Plain token refresh is insufficient because it preserves the old scopes.
persistence_rule: Never write balances, positions, account identifiers, or other private account values to the public repository. Runtime status only.
reauth_rule: Only an explicit OAuth reconnect/re-authorization that grants the required connector scopes can clear 403308. Plain access-token refresh MUST NOT be treated as repair.
pass_transition_rule: Only a fresh same-run success of BOTH account_balance and stock_positions may transition ACCOUNT to PASS.
